title: Prevalence of Menstrual Cycle Related Pain Complains in Adolescents and Young Adults
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to determine the prevalence of menstrual cycle related pain complains in adolescents and young adults.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 3rd year high school girls
* 1st year university young females

Exclusion Criteria:

* pre-menarcheal girls
study_population: 3rd year high school girls and 1st year university young females having a routine visit to the school doctor or student doctor.
